run_mrp_process: run the mrp process named rostf using mrp.main() to start the CLI
define_conda_process: define an mrp process with a Conda runtime specifying channels, dependencies, and run_command
configure_conda_channels: configure conda channels like conda-forge and robostack for the mrp Conda runtime
set_run_command: set the run_command to python rostf.py for the mrp Conda process definition
review_msetup: review the msetup.py file to understand the mrp process definition and Conda runtime configuration
